span.p:
Raw CVSS Vector String
Format: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Strict Regex Pattern Validation
Grammar check against FIRST.org 8 metric groups

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Vector Tokenizer & Metric Extractor
Parse AV, AC, PR, UI, Scope, C, I, A

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Impact Sub-Score (ISS)
ISS = 1.0 - [(1 - C) × (1 - I) × (1 - A)]

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Unchanged Scope Impact
Impact = 6.42 × ISS

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Changed Scope Impact
Impact = 7.52 × (ISS - 0.029) - 3.25 × (ISS - 0.02)^15

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Exploitability Sub-Score
Exploitability = 8.22 × AV × AC × PR × UI

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Raw Score Formula
Raw = min(Impact + Exploitability, 10.0)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FIRST.org Appendix A Roundup
roundup(val) = Math.ceil(round(val, 9) × 10) / 10
